trek.name: Carros de Foc
trek.nutrition: Maintenance-plus — EAT. No calorie deficit at any point during the trek.
trek.notes: High mountain hut-to-hut circuit. Consecutive days on feet with a pack; the limiter is cumulative fatigue and the two high passes, not speed.
trek.connectivity: Refuge-based, limited/no signal. FIT files will NOT be uploaded daily during the trek.

2026-08-28.notes: Lowest day of the trek. Starts at noon after the drive in, so afternoon heat is the only real factor.

2026-08-29.hazard: Port de Ratera 2550 m — exposed high col, afternoon thunderstorm risk.
2026-08-29.notes: Start early to clear Port de Ratera well before afternoon convection builds.

2026-08-30.hazard: LONGEST STAGE of the trek — time on feet plus afternoon storm exposure.
2026-08-30.notes: Dawn start, non-negotiable. The goal is to be off the high ground before storms build. Pace conservatively from the first hour; this is the day most likely to be under-fuelled.

2026-08-31.hazard: Coll de Contraix 2748 m — THE CRUX of the circuit. Highest pass, steep boulder/scree, slow technical ground on both sides.
2026-08-31.notes: Dawn start. Short in distance but the hardest stage technically; it arrives on day 4 with accumulated fatigue. Descent is the risky half.

2026-09-01.hazard: None significant — the recovery day of the circuit.
2026-09-01.notes: Shortest day after the crux. Use it to eat, rehydrate and take load off the legs before the long final descent.

2026-09-02.hazard: -1120 m sustained descent — quadriceps eccentric load on already-tired legs. Highest fall/knee risk of the trek.
2026-09-02.notes: Finish day. Long descent, not a long climb: use poles, shorten stride, take the descent in blocks rather than pushing to finish.

trek.load_note: estimated_tss values are PLANNING ESTIMATES for briefing context only. They are NOT written into the training-load model and must never be presented as measured TSS.

phases.name: Trek-prep block
phases.focus: descending, climbing, time-on-feet, pack carrying — not 10k speed
phases.nutrition: Fat-loss calorie deficit; easing toward maintenance from ~2026-08-09

phases.name: Taper into Carros de Foc
phases.focus: FRESHNESS. Shed fatigue, keep the legs ticking over. No fitness is gained in this window — only lost through overreaching.
phases.nutrition: Maintenance calories. The deficit is over. Do not diet into the trek.

phases.name: Carros de Foc trek
phases.focus: Execute the itinerary. Cumulative fatigue management, hydration, and the two high passes.

current_phase.focus: FRESHNESS. Shed fatigue, keep the legs ticking over. No fitness is gained in this window — only lost through overreaching.

2026-07-30.detail: 6 km / 170 m ascent with pack — low intensity trek prep

2026-07-31.detail: 30-40 min easy treadmill @ 6.3-7.0 km/h — aerobic base

2026-08-02.detail: 8-10 km / 300 m ascent with pack — progressive trek prep

2026-08-03.detail: 40-45 min treadmill @ 7.4 km/h — aerobic steady state

2026-08-05.detail: 10+ km / 400 m ascent with full pack — extended trek simulation

2026-08-08.detail: 35-40 min treadmill — include 10-15 min at 8.0-8.2 km/h

2026-08-09.detail: 10-12 km with pack — nutrition transitions to maintenance today

2026-08-17.detail: 30-40 min easy — OPTIONAL. Skip without guilt if fatigue or HRV says so.

2026-08-19.detail: 40-50 min light pack walk — OPTIONAL. Light load, flat ground, no hill repeats.

2026-08-23.detail: 20-30 min very light, or rest. Athlete's choice on the day.

2026-08-24.detail: Very light, or rest. Athlete's choice on the day.

2026-08-25.detail: Rest — pack the trek bag today.

2026-08-27.detail: Fly TLV→BCN 05:45, drive to Espot, overnight Hotel Roya. NO TRAINING.
2026-08-27.guidance: Hydrate through the flight and drive, carb-load, protect sleep. Do not train — not even 'a shakeout'. Movement today should be limited to walking around the airport and stretching the legs at the car stops.

taper_policy: During the taper (2026-08-16 → 2026-08-27) the planned session above is the ONLY session. Do not substitute or add hill walks, pack walks, quality runs or intervals. Optional sessions may be skipped entirely; skipping is not a failure. Freshness beats fitness in this window.

trek_mode.data_policy: Limited connectivity — FIT files will NOT be uploaded daily. Missing activity data on these dates is EXPECTED and is not a fault. Do not warn about missing/unprocessed files, do not treat an absent FIT as a rest day, and do not zero-fill load. Use the stage's estimated_tss as the stand-in for the day's load.
trek_mode.briefing_policy: If metrics are stale or absent, say so plainly in one line and give plan-based guidance from the itinerary. Never invent metric values to fill the gap.
